newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar Airways gets $19.2 mln government loan.
newsitem.headline: Qatar Airways gets $19.2 mln government loan.

text.p: Qatar said on Wednesday it had granted a 70 million riyal ($19.2 million) government loan to privately owned Qatar Airways to expand its fleet and operations.

The announcement was made after a cabinet meeting but an emiri decree did not specify the duration or the rate of interest on the loan. Officials said loans granted by the state were generally interest-free.
A Qatar Airways official said the loan would help it lease and buy new aircraft, open new routes and modernise its operations into the next century. ($1=3.64 riyals)
